args.title: Ironbark: Warehouse Automation 2026 – Combined Summary
args.body:
- Autonomous carts raised warehouse pick rates by 18% in 2026.
- Integration took about twice as long as planned.
- The companion piece says the biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.

Sources: https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/warehouse ; https://insights.ironbark.example/warehouse/companion
